python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio
import json
import websockets

async def bounded_limits():
    async with websockets.connect("ws://127.0.0.1:18080/ws/auth-lab", subprotocols=["payloader-lab-v1"]) as socket:
        for sequence in range(5):
            await socket.send(json.dumps({"action": "ping", "sequence": sequence}))
        await socket.send(json.dumps({"action": "echo", "marker": "A" * 65536}))
        print(await asyncio.wait_for(socket.recv(), timeout=2))

asyncio.run(bounded_limits())
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio
import json
import websockets

async def capture_lab_messages():
    async with websockets.connect("ws://127.0.0.1:18080/ws/lab", origin="https://same-origin.invalid", subprotocols=["payloader-lab-v1"]) as socket:
        await socket.send(json.dumps({"action": "echo", "marker": "WS_CAPTURE_C3"}))
        for _ in range(3):
            message = await asyncio.wait_for(socket.recv(), timeout=2)
            print(message)
            if "WS_CAPTURE_C3" in message:
                break

asyncio.run(capture_lab_messages())
PY
